seo.title: ChatSched — Managed Advertising, Marketplace & Publisher Network
seo.description: Tell ChatSched your goal and a campaign manager builds it for you, or browse and book South African publishers and creators directly yourself — social media, influencer, website, podcast and radio.

hero.subtitle: ChatSched plans and runs your advertising across publishers, creators and channels South African audiences already trust — or browse the marketplace and book it yourself. Your call.

metrics.paidOut: Paid Out To Publishers This Year

audienceSplit.heading: Whichever side you're on, it's built for you.
audienceSplit.businessTitle: Reach the audience your customers already trust
audienceSplit.businessBody: R199/month gets you the marketplace, managed campaigns and a R199 launch credit. Browsing is free — sending a request needs the subscription.
audienceSplit.publisherTitle: Monetise the audience you've already built
audienceSplit.publisherBody: R99/month for full Publisher Network access — approve requests, set your own price, opportunities, earnings and analytics. Listing a basic profile stays free.

layers.title: Three ways in, one platform behind them.
layers.subtitle: Done for you, self-service, or somewhere in between — pick the layer that fits how hands-on you want to be.
layers.agencyBody: Tell ChatSched your goal, audience and budget. A campaign manager plans it, books the right publishers, and reports back — you approve, we handle the rest.
layers.marketplaceBody: Browse, filter and compare publishers and creators yourself. Book directly, pay only once it's confirmed — no campaign manager required.
layers.networkBody: R99/month gets a publisher a verified profile, campaign opportunities, earnings dashboard and analytics — the full creator platform, not a directory listing.

channelsSection.title: More boards to put your business on.
channelsSection.subtitle: Four new ways to reach South African audiences beyond social pages — same direct, transparent approach.

valueProp.badge: Why not just run social ads?
valueProp.title1: Zero ad spend wasted on algorithms.
valueProp.title2: 100% aimed at people who already trust the page.
valueProp.body: Social ad platforms bid your budget against a black box and hope the right person scrolls past at the right second. ChatSched puts you directly in front of an audience a real local creator already built — no auction, no algorithm, no guessing.

howItWorks.scene1Title: Find your billboard, or list your page
howItWorks.scene2Title: Send a request, or get one to review
howItWorks.scene3Title: It goes live — you get proof, or you get seen

payment.title: Money is held in escrow until the placement goes live.
payment.step1: Business requests, creator approves — or it auto-closes after {{days}} days of no response.
payment.step2: Business pays into escrow (card or EFT) — held there until the creator posts and marks it live.
payment.step3: Creator is paid out within {{hours}} hours of going live — {{share}}% to the creator, a flat {{commission}}% platform fee.
